// NOTIF-P2 GREEN fixture: the same PII column, tagged with the canonical multi-line six-tag
// #[personal_data(...)] form the Notif schema uses (the recipient/principal pseudonym columns). The
// lint must ADMIT it (it is now erasable + RoPA-mapped).
pub struct NotifPrefRow {
    pub tenant_id: String,
    pub region: String,
    #[personal_data(
        category = Identifier,
        role = TenantContent,
        basis = Contract,
        retention = UntilContractEnd,
        erasure = Pseudonymise,
        subject_locator = "display_name",
    )]
    pub display_name: String,
}
